To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the output power of a He-Ne laser depends on the homogeneous and inhomogeneously broadened parts of the gain, the homogeneous part dominates the output power at low gas pressure and the inhomogeneously part is dominant at high pressure, the optimum decoupling of the He- Ne laser is determined by the homogeneous broadening, and the maximum output power depends on both types of broadened lines, and is determined by the inhomogeneosly broadened part.
the output power of He-Ne lasers is limited by the saturation of gain and by optimum decoupling of the laser.
the output power of a He-Ne laser with homogeneous and inhomogeneously broadened transitions is essentially determined by homogeneous broadening.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: (i) What are the optimum operating conditions (gas pressures, gas mixtures, tube lengths and diameters, etc.) for maximum output power of He-Ne lasers?
the influence of the broadening of laser lines on gain saturation, the optimum decoupling of a He-Ne laser, and the maximum output power.
the influence of inhomogeneous and homogeneous line broadening on the gain saturation and the output of the He–Ne laser.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the He-Ne gas discharge is not a pure homogeneous broadened system.
the He-Ne gas discharge is a complex system of different physical processes.
the homogeneous line broadening is the most important one, and that the inhomogeneous part has only a minor influence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in the He-Ne gas discharge a homogeneous line broadening exists which can be described by the theory of collisional broadening.
the He-Ne-laser is a very suitable tool for the investigation of the influence of inhomogeneous and homogeneous line broadening on laser action.
the He-Ne lasers with the optimum output power are the ones with the smallest possible diameters and the longest lengths.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the output power of a He-Ne laser can be increased by using a tube with a larger diameter, and the optimum decoupling distance can be reduced by using a tube that has a shorter length.

the gain saturation and output power of a laser are determined by the inhomogeneous and homogeneous parts of the broadening in the following manner: if the homogeneous part is dominant, the gain saturates and the maximum output is reached at the same time; if the inhomogeneous part is dominant, there is a gain saturation without a maximum output.

the gain saturation is not only determined by the homogeneous broadening, but also by the inhomogeneous one, and that the latter is the dominant effect in the case of optimum decoupling of a He-Ne laser.
